dish.title: Crispy Skillet Chicken Sandwiches
dish.description: Pound-thin chicken cutlets seared in a skillet and stacked on rolls with lemon-dijon mayonnaise, lettuce, and tomato.

provenance.process: FlavorWeave Catalog Factory Dry Run #1, Grok Bot only

recipe_version.immutability_note: v1 has not been planned, shopped, cooked, or rated. Any material change after that history needs v2. This dry run does not rewrite a prior version.
recipe_version.title: Crispy Skillet Chicken Sandwiches
recipe_version.description: Pound-thin chicken cutlets seared in a skillet and stacked on rolls with lemon-dijon mayonnaise, lettuce, and tomato.

ingredients.name: kosher salt
ingredients.note: divided: 3/4 tsp on the chicken, 1/4 tsp in the sauce

ingredients.name: canola oil
ingredients.note: divided: about 2 tbsp for each skillet batch

ingredients.name: mayonnaise
ingredients.note: store-bought; egg and oil style, dairy-free — check the label

steps.title: Pound and season
steps.body: Butterfly the boneless skinless chicken breast into 4 pieces and pound each to about 1/4 inch. Pat dry. Season both sides with 3/4 tsp of the kosher salt, the black pepper, and the garlic powder.

steps.title: Mix the sauce
steps.body: Stir the mayonnaise, dijon mustard, the zest and juice of the lemon, the fresh parsley, the garlic, and the remaining 1/4 tsp kosher salt. The mayonnaise is store-bought. This lemon-dijon mayonnaise is the only sauce. Use a dairy-free mayonnaise or the dairy-free label does not hold.

steps.title: Dredge
steps.body: Beat the eggs in a shallow bowl. Spread the all-purpose flour on a plate. Dip each piece in flour, then in egg, and set them on a clean plate. Let the excess egg drip off.

steps.title: Sear
steps.body: Heat a 12-inch skillet over medium-high. Add 2 tbsp of the canola oil. When it shimmers, add 2 pieces. Cook about 2 1/2 to 3 minutes per side, until the crust is deep golden and the center is 165°F. Repeat with the remaining 2 tbsp canola oil and the remaining pieces. If the crust darkens before 165°F, lower the heat to medium for the last minute. Do not crowd the pan.

steps.title: Toast the rolls
steps.body: Wipe out loose browned bits if they will scorch. Toast the sandwich rolls, cut side down, in the skillet over medium heat for about 45 to 60 seconds.

steps.title: Assemble
steps.body: Spread the lemon-dijon mayonnaise on the rolls. Add romaine lettuce, tomato, and a chicken cutlet. Serve right away. No fries and no pickles are part of this recipe.

equipment: two shallow bowls or a bowl and a plate
recipe_version.heat: Skillet over medium-high; lower to medium only if the crust darkens before the center is done.
recipe_version.doneness: 165°F in the center of each cutlet. Color is not the doneness test.

classification_history.reason: D-03 rubric: effort factors [1, 1, 1, 1, 1] = 5; complexity factors [1, 0, 1, 0] = 2. Matches d03-design JUNIPER-CLASSIFICATION-BATCH. Butterfly and pound cutlets plus a dredge station is steady prep (1). Two skillet batches need watching to 165F (1). Cutlets plus a stirred lemon-dijon mayo and assembly = components 1. Dredge-and-sear is technique 1 (no floor: technique <2). Skillet, dredge bowls, thermometer, assembly = coordination 1. Score 5 = moderate. Complexity: 12 counted supermarket items (band 1), no specialty items (0), a second build (mayo sauce) = breadth 1. Score 2 = standard. Legacy 'weeknight' is time-flavored; time is not effort.

curator_preflight.detail: Every listed ingredient name appears in a step. No finish item is introduced only in the method.
The cooking fat is a named ingredient with a quantity and is used in the method: canola oil.
Lemon-dijon mayonnaise is mixed in step 2 from store-bought mayonnaise, store-bought dijon mustard, lemon, parsley, garlic, and salt. Mayonnaise and dijon are labeled store-bought. No unnamed sauce.
prep 12 + cook 16 = total 28. Step durations are written to match that sum without hiding a required wait.
Base is 4 servings. Quantities scale by 0.25 / 0.5 / 1. See scaling_notes for cloves, eggs, wine, and time that must not be scaled blindly.

scaling_notes.1: One 4 oz cutlet, 1 roll, 2 slices of tomato, 1 lettuce leaf. Keep 1 egg even though the scaled amount is half an egg; a smaller egg wash still has to coat. Use about 2 tbsp flour, 1 tbsp canola oil, and 2 tbsp mayonnaise with 3/4 tsp dijon. One small garlic clove is enough. Cook in one batch, still to 165°F, about 3 minutes per side.
scaling_notes.2: Two cutlets in one batch. One egg is still enough. Halve the flour, oil, sauce, lemon (use half a lemon), parsley, and salt. Same skillet temperature and 165°F target.
scaling_notes.4: As written. Two skillet batches so the pan is not crowded. Oil is split, 2 tbsp then 2 tbsp.
